content.comment_body: Hello, I have a machine with two analog ammeters (AC 0-5A). I am seeking advice on choosing suitable hardware to measure the current and connect it to my [product_name]. I need to use the current values from both ammeters as variables for my project. I have attached an image of the machine's circuit diagram, with the red circle indicating one of the ammeters.

You will need an analog expansion module and two current transformers. The current transformers should be rated for up to 5A AC and provide an output signal of either 0-10V DC or 0/4-20mA DC. Could you specify which version of [product_name] you have? Please share its exact article number.

Thank you for your guidance. My device has the following article number: [article_no]. Would this module, [article_no], be appropriate for my setup? Also, what type of current transformers would you recommend?

Hello [user_name], I suggest you avoid modifying the existing circuit. It's better to use an additional current converter that outputs directly to 0-10V, or after 0-20mA. In that case, you will need an analog input expansion or an auxiliary circuit. Both approaches are generally reliable. Example 1, Example 2. Greetings [user_name] (translated with Google)
Thanks for your help, I'll try this approach.
